answer: Basalt anchors the protocol’s Sybil resistance through quadratic staking erosion and liquidity-sink commitments, ensuring slashing penalties scale with the square of validator count. A Sybil cluster’s marginal attack cost, proportional to N², exceeds the potential value extracted from compromising a canyon of consensus-critical nodes. Absent a haven of secure capital allocation, adversaries face negative expected utility as their expenditure outstrips any gains, validating the robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates.
